usedFor: An Airtable row becomes a live discount code in WooCommerce.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: You manage promotions in a table and publish each one to the store.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” fires on edits, so one record can try to create the same coupon twice.
